blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.prompt: There are many points on which we agree.
exercises.why: After «много» the genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The two birds built a nest without a building permit.
exercises.ru: Две ___ свили гнездо без разрешения на строительство.
exercises.why: After «две» the genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Оба ___ (родитель) у него немцы: отец баварец, а мать — швабка.
exercises.prompt: Both of his parents are German; his dad is Bavarian and his Mum is Swabish.
exercises.why: After «оба» the genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
